_note: Hand review of every mapping the bill finder makes on the routine sweep pages (scripts/bill-finder-ground-truth-2026-11.mjs). Until the v6 keys, no sweep page was about a mapped key, so any sweep mapping was false. The v6 keys (energy production, school choice, health care access, cutting spending) are ordinary campaign topics, so a sweep page can now name a real bill on its key. Each mapping here was read against the page and marked correct (the named bill is about the key, in a passage about it) or false. The report counts a sweep mapping that is not in this list, or is marked false, as a false mapping. Reviewed 2026-11-12.

reviewed.why: A campaign issue page; the passage on health coverage (a public option, caps on costs) names the Affordable Care Act, a health coverage law.
"Protect and improve the Affordable Care Act (ACA) and reverse … cuts to the ACA": the ACA, on health coverage.

reviewed.bill: Cornyn-Supported Working Families Tax Cuts Act
reviewed.why: His health care issue page lists a release headlined "Funding Made Possible Through Cornyn-Supported Working Families Tax Cuts Act" (the finder keeps the "Cornyn-Supported" lead-in of the headline in the name): health funding from the Working Families Tax Cut Act (the 2025 reconciliation law, which changed Medicaid and created a rural health fund).
The same page lists his op-ed "The Working Families Tax Cut Act Prescribes Real Remedies for Health Care": the same law, on health care.
"the Medicaid expansion under the Affordable Care Act": the ACA, on health coverage.
"Efforts to expand access have stalled in Washington (Medicare for All Act)": a health coverage bill, on access.
